summary: ITER183 · APP-WIDE NAMING LOCK Phase 1 — frontend smoke + naming compliance test. Logged in as admin@moodfordesign.com / Blueprint2024!. Verified login, dashboard, /relations/leads, /studio-pulse (+ /studio/pulse + /dashboard/pulse), /inspirations, /workspace/projects render without ANY banned terms (atmosfera, atmosphere, curatoriale, curatorial, Studio Pulse, Journey Pulse, Nuova Relazione, Respiro dello Studio, Atmosfere Emergenti, Intensità Curatoriale, Relazioni in Silenzio, Movimenti Recenti) appearing in body.innerText on any tested route. Sidebar CTA renders 'Nuovo Lead' (aria-label='Nuovo Lead', icon '+'), data-testid='sidebar-new-relationship-trigger' preserved. Clicking the CTA opens NewRelationshipModal — eyebrow displays 'CRM · NUOVO LEAD' and body lists 'Nuovo Lead / Prospect esistente / Cliente esistente' choices (the iter169 regression where eyebrow was not found is RESOLVED). data-testid='new-relationship-modal' preserved. Studio Pulse page: testid 'studio-pulse-page' present; eyebrow 'BLUEPRINT DASHBOARD' visible; section eyebrows confirmed visible after scroll: 'ATTIVITÀ DELLO STUDIO', 'ATTIVITÀ DESIGNER', 'LEAD INATTIVI'. Forbidden Studio Pulse eyebrows are all absent. i18n: switching localStorage to en-US and en-GB and reloading /dashboard produced no raw missing-key strings in body and no banned terms. Inspirations filter chip label is 'Stile' (NOT 'Atmosfera') — PASS. Workspace/projects clean.

ui_bugs.issue: Raw i18n key 'nav.section.content' rendered as breadcrumb segment on /inspirations (visible literal text 'nav.section.content > Inspirations'). The key is referenced in /app/frontend/src/components/common/NavigableBreadcrumb.jsx (lines 96, 105, 106) but is NOT defined in /app/frontend/src/i18n/strings/{it-IT,en-US,en-GB}.json. Pre-existing (NOT introduced by ITER183), but visible on a tested route and breaks UX polish.
Bottom-left dev overlay shows 'EDITORIAL · DEBUG runtime 3 · missing 4' — implying 4 runtime-missing i18n keys somewhere. Pre-existing dev overlay; should be hidden in prod build or those keys added.

integration_issues.issue: No interactive element on /inspirations opens a modal with data-testid='curatorial-inspirations-modal'. Visible CTAs are 'Aggiungi riferimento', 'STUDIO COLLECTIONS™', 'BRAND ATLAS™', 'IMPORTA CATALOGO FORNITORE' — none of these mount the curatorial-inspirations-modal (which lives in the Moodboard editor surface). The component file /app/frontend/src/blueprint/moodboard/CuratorialInspirationsModal.jsx and its data-testid are preserved in source, and filter label 'Stile' is correctly shown on the Inspirations page itself. If the spec required the modal to also be reachable from /inspirations, this is a route gap — otherwise pass.

issues: Two section eyebrows from the canon spec — 'TREND EMERGENTI' and 'ATTIVITÀ RECENTI' — are NOT rendered on screen in the current empty-CRM founder-only state (CRM is empty, so these data-driven sections are likely conditionally hidden). 'BLUEPRINT DASHBOARD', 'ATTIVITÀ DELLO STUDIO', 'ATTIVITÀ DESIGNER', 'LEAD INATTIVI' all render. Recommend verifying the missing two eyebrows render with seeded data.

action_items: Add i18n value for 'nav.section.content' across it-IT/en-US/en-GB (and other locales) — currently leaks as raw key in breadcrumb on /inspirations and /moodboards.
Confirm Studio Pulse sections 'TREND EMERGENTI' and 'ATTIVITÀ RECENTI' render with seeded data (cannot be validated in current empty-CRM state).
Optional: hide 'EDITORIAL · DEBUG runtime 3 · missing 4' overlay in non-dev builds or resolve the 4 reported missing-key counters.
critical_code_review_comments: Login → dashboard flow shows ~80 console errors (401/403 on protected endpoints during initial bootstrap) and React 'Cannot update a component while rendering' warnings from LocalizationOverlay (LoginPage/Sidebar). Pre-existing per iter169; not blocking ITER183 acceptance but worth addressing in a future stability pass.
/dashboard/pulse and /studio-pulse and /studio/pulse all redirect/render the same Blueprint Dashboard surface — naming canon is uniform; redirect/alias chain works as documented in ITER183 report §4.

Naming canon verified: 0 banned terms (atmosfera/atmosphere/curatoriale/curatorial/relazione/relationship/Studio Pulse/Journey Pulse/Nuova Relazione/Respiro dello Studio/Movimenti Recenti) found in any tested page's body.innerText across /dashboard, /relations/leads, /studio-pulse, /studio/pulse, /dashboard/pulse, /inspirations, /workspace/projects in it-IT, en-US, en-GB.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (13/14 acceptance assertions PASS; 1 partial: 2 of 6 Studio Pulse section eyebrows not present in empty-CRM state)

seed_data_creation: None — tenant in FOUNDER ONLY state (no CRM rows); 'TREND EMERGENTI' and 'ATTIVITÀ RECENTI' Studio Pulse sections likely require data to render.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ITER183 naming lock effectively delivered on UI. Login lands on /dashboard. Sidebar collapsed by default; clicking '+' icon ([data-testid='sidebar-new-relationship-trigger']) opens NewRelationshipModal — modal eyebrow text 'CRM · NUOVO LEAD' (uppercased by CSS). To re-verify modal eyebrow, query element inside [data-testid='new-relationship-modal'] and inner_text (don't rely on body.innerText which may not capture portal text in some browsers but did here). To check Studio Pulse 'TREND EMERGENTI' / 'ATTIVITÀ RECENTI', seed CRM with at least 1 lead + 1 activity log entry then re-visit /studio/pulse. Pre-existing missing i18n key: 'nav.section.content' (visible literal in breadcrumb on /inspirations and /moodboards) — not ITER183 fallout but should be patched.
rca of the issue: No critical bugs. Main remaining issues are: (a) raw i18n key 'nav.section.content' rendered in NavigableBreadcrumb because the key was never added to any locale file — this is a pre-existing breadcrumb infrastructure gap, not an ITER183 regression. RCA: NavigableBreadcrumb.jsx references nav.section.content at lines 96/105/106 but no string file defines it; t() falls back to printing the key literal. Mitigation: add 'section.content' under 'nav' object in /app/frontend/src/i18n/strings/{it-IT,en-US,en-GB,es-ES,de-DE,fr-FR,ar}.json (e.g. it-IT: 'Contenuti', en-US: 'Content'). (b) Studio Pulse 'TREND EMERGENTI'/'ATTIVITÀ RECENTI' sections not visible because empty CRM means data-driven sections are conditionally suppressed — this requires seeded data to validate, not a copy/canon failure.
